tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /ma ṇi'i phan yon gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo shākya mu ṇa ye/ sngon tshe 'gro ba kun gyi don du thugs bskyed rlabs chen spyod pa rab spyad cing*/ /rnam dag smon lam nyer btab 'bras smin bde ldan zhing mchog grub pa der/ /mngon sangs rgyas nas gzhan dag 'khrid mdzad rgyal kun so sor rtog pa'i dngos/ /padma'i rigs rnams yongs kyi rjer gyur mgon po 'od dpag med la 'dud/ /phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs kun gyi thugs rje'i dpung*/ /gcig bsdus snang mtha'i sras kyi tshul bzung nas/ /khams gsum 'gro ba 'dren la zla bral ba/ /'jig rten gsum mgon spyan ras gzigs la 'dud/ /mgon de snyigs dus rgyal bstan spel ba'i ched/ /bod kyi mi rje'i tshul bstan srod btsan zhes/ /thub bstan srol btod dge bcu'i khrims mdzad pa/ /chos kyi rgyal por gyur pa de la 'dud/ /rgyal rnams thugs rje 'gro la rjes brtse bar/ /kun nas mtshungs mod snyigs dus 'gro ba la/ /lhag par rjes brtse mdzad 'phrin rgya che ba/ /rje btsun spyan ras gzigs zhes rab tu grags/ /gang de'i chos tshul zab rgyas grangs mang yang*/ /kun gyi snying po gcig bsdus yig drug ces/ /phan yon rgya cher grags las mdor bsdus zhig / gzhan dag dad pa spel phyir brjaud par bya/ /de yang spyir sangs rgyas thams cad kyang rang don mthar phyin nas gzhan gyi don kho na mdzad pa las ma 'das kyang*/ /thub pa'i bstan pa 'di la sems can gyi don mdzad pa la lhag par phul du byung ba ni 'phags pa rigs gsum gyi mgon po nyid yin la/ de'i nang nas mchog dman mtha' dag la 'phrin las 'jug pa rgya che ba ni 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug go /'di'i sgrub thabs dang bsngags pa brjod pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung mang yang mtshon tsam ni/ za ma tog bkod pa'i mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po'i yul ci 'dra ba de 'dra ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la yang ma mchis so zhes dang*/

de nyid las spyan ras gzigs kyi mtshan nas brjod pa ni sangs rgyas stong phrag du ma'i mtshan nas brjod pa dang phan yon mnyam pa dang mchod pa'i bsod nams yang mnyam par bshad cing*/ yang rigs kyi bu de lta bas na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po ni dkon pa'o/ /sems can rnams kyi pha dang mar gyur pa'o/ /sems can thams cad la mi 'jigs pa sbyin par byed pa'o/ /sems can thams cad la lam ston par byed pa'o/ /sems can thams cad la dge ba'i bshes gnyen du gyur pa ste/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po ni de lta bu'o/ /de'i ming 'dzin pa yang dkon te/ de de'i yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags kyi ming gis rjes su dran na de'i tshe ba spu'i khung bu de dag tu skye'o/ /slar 'khor bar mi 'khor ro zhes pa nas/ rigs kyi bu yi ge drug pa'i rigs sngags de ni byang chub sems dpal sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs kyi snying po dam pa'o/ /gang dag snying po dam pa shes pa de ni thar pa shes pa'o/ /zhes dang*/ gang dag yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags chen mo 'di rtag tu zlos pa la brtson pa'i sems can de dag ni bsod nams dang ldan pa yin no/ /de dag zlos par byed pa'i tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gaṅga'i klung gi bye ma snyed phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu 'du bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes sogs phan yon gzhan mang du gsungs pa dang*/ yang*/ rigs kyi bu gang yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags chen mo 'di 'drir 'jug pa des ni chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong 'drir 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa lha'i gser rin po che las byed cing*/ byas nas nyin gcig tu ring srel 'jug pa de'i 'bras bu rnam par smin pa ni yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags chen mo'i yi ge 'bru gcig gi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa ste yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/

/zhes pa nas/ rigs kyi bu gang yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'dzin pa ni de lta bu la sogs te ting nge 'dzin brgya rtsa brgyad thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang*/ rigs kyi bu yul 'khor mor 'jug pa'i grong khyer chen po na gang yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags chen mo 'dzin par byed/ klog par byed/ tshul bzhin yid la byed pa'i chos smra ba yod do/ /zhes pa nas/ chos smra ba de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa dang mnyam par blta'o zhes dang*/ yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags chen mo'i rgyal mo 'di ni dkon pa'i tshig ste/ 'di ni rdo rje'i tshig go /mi phyed pa'i tshig go /bla na med pa'i ye shes kyi tshig go /mi zad pa'i ye shes kyi tshig zhes pa nas/ chos thams cad la 'jug pa'i tshig go /zhes dang*/ rnal 'byor thams cad kyi nang na yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo 'di ni 'bras bu'i snying por gyur pa'o/ /zhes pas mtshon te mang du gsungs so/ /gzhan yang*/ ma ṇi bka' 'bum las/ de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba la 'di skad ces bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu oṃ ma ṇi padme hūṃ/ zhes pa'i yi ge drug pa'i rigs sngags ni/ 'di lta ste dper na sa'i rdul phra rab snyed kyi tshad ni nges bzung bar nus kyi/ yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags lan gcig bzlas pa'i bsod nams kyi tshad ni bzung bar mi nus so/ /rgya mtsho'i chu ni thig pa re re nas bgrang bar nus kyi/ yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags 'di lan gcig brjod pa'i bsod nams kyi tshad ni bgrang bar mi nus so/ /zhes sogs dpe don mang du sbyar nas gsungs te za ma tog gi mdo'i don bshad par snang ngo*/ /yang*/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūṃ/ zhes pa'i rig sngags lan gcig bzlas pas pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /la la zhig gis yi ge drug pa bris pa la lag pas reg pa de dag kyang phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/

/yi ge drug pa'i gzungs sngags 'di lan gcig bzung na de bzhin gshegs pa la na bza' dang*/ bshos dang*/ mal stan dang*/ na ba'i rkyen sman dang*/ yo byad thams cad kyis bkur bstir byed par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang*/ padma cod pan gyi rgyud las/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis 'di skad ces smras so/ /nga yid la byas nas oṃ ma ṇi padme hūṃ zhes pa'i rig sngags 'di bzlas pa'i rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang yin pa des lan cig bzlas brjod byed dam yid la byas nas lus la bcangs na/ mtshams med pa lnga dang de dang nye ba lnga dang*/ sdig pa thams cad byang nas sems can dmyal ba dang*/ yi dwags dang*/ dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang*/ mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad spangs shing lus ngag yid gsum sdug bsngal bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gcan gzan dang*/ srin po dang*/ mi ma yin pa thams cad dang*/ nad dang 'jigs pa thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /chos kyi sku'i don rtogs nas gzugs kyi sku thugs rje chen po'i zhal mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang*/ yi ge drug ma'i mdo las/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang gis yi ge drug ma shes rab kyi lha mo yid la byas nas rig sngags 'di bzlas brjod byas na nad thams cad las thar bar 'gyur/ zhes pa nas/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ro/ /zhes sogs mang du gsungs so/ /gzhan yang*/ yig drug gi mtshon don dang*/ phan yon gzhan 'ga' zhig brjod na/ bka' 'bum las/ dang po dbye ba'i don la dgongs te yi ge drug la bsdu ba ni/ thugs rje chen po'i chos la dbye ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod kyang*/ gsung gi snying po yi ge drug pa la bsdus nas gsungs so/ /yi ge drug po gang yin na/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūṃ zhes pa yin no/ /oṃ ye shes rnam pa lnga zhes pa'i a chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ thig le me long lta bu'i ye shes/ zla tshes mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/

na ro so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ nā da bya ba grub pa'i ye shes so/ /de bzhin du ma thugs rje kun la khyab pa/ ṇi 'khor ba rang log pad thabs dang shes rab/ me ye shes rang gsal/ hūṃ rdo rje lta bu mi 'gyur ba'i don no/ /yang*/ oṃ ye shes lnga ldan lha yi skyabs/ /'pho ltung zhi nas skye sgo gcod/ /ma snying rjai chen po lha min skyabs/ /'thab rtsod zhi nas skye sgo gcod/ /ṇi byams pa chen po mi yi skyabs/ /'gyur ba zhi nas skye sgo gcod/ /pad dga' ba chen po byol song skyabs/ /glen lkugs zhi nas skye sgo gcod/ /me btang snyoms chen po yi dwags skyabs/ /bkres skom zhi nas skye sgo gcod/ /hūṃ thugs rje chen po dmyal ba'i skyabs/ /tsha grang zhi nas skye sgo gcod/ /zhes dang*/ yang*/ sku drug dang sbyar na/ oṃ chos kyi sku/ ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ ṇi sprul pa'i sku/ pad ngo bo nyid kyi sku/ me mngon par byang chub pa'i sku/ hūṃ mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku ste sku drug lhun gyis grub pa thob par byed pa yang yig drug yin no/ /zhes dang*/ rigs drug dang sbyar na/ oṃ rigs thams cad 'dus pa thugs rje chen po/ ma rnam par snang mdzad/ ṇi rdo rje sems dpa'/ pad rin chen 'byung ldan/ me snang ba mtha' yas/ hūṃ don yod grub pa/ rigs drug gi sangs rgyas kyang yig drug bzlas pas thob par byed pa yin no/ /rigs drug gi yum dang sbyar na/ oṃ rigs thams cad 'dus pa'i yum yi ge drug ma/ ma nam mkha' kun tu bzang mo/ ṇi sa sangs rgyas spyan ma/ pad me gos dkar mo/ me chu mā ma ki hūṃ rlung dam tshig sgrol ma/ yum de dag kyang yig drug bzlas pas thob par 'gyur ro/ /mkha' 'gro ma drug dang sbyar na/ oṃ mkha' 'gro'i rigs 'dus pa rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ ma sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro /ṇi rdo rje mkha' 'gro pad rin chen mkha' 'gro /me padma mkha' 'gro

/hūṃ las kyi mkha' 'gro ste yig drug bzlas na de dag gis byin gyis rlob par mdzad do/ /phyin drug dang sbyar na/ /oṃ gyis sbyin pa'i phar phyin/ mas tshul khrims/ ṇis bzod pa/ pad kyis brtson 'grus/ mes bsam gtan/ hūṃ gis shes rab kyi phar phyin mtshon te yig drug bzlas na de drug rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /dug lnga dang nyon mongs kun 'joms pa dang sbyar na/ oṃ gyis gti mug /mas zhe sdang*/ ṇis nga rgyal/ pad kyis 'dod chags/ mes phrag dog /hūṃ gis nyon mongs thams cad 'joms par byed de yig drug bzlas pas 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /ye shes drug dang sbyar na/ oṃ chos dbyings ye shes/ ma me long lta bu'i ye shes/ ṇi mnyam nyid ye shes/ pad sor rtog ye shes/ me bya grub ye shes/ hūṃ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes te de drug ma ṇis rang rgyud la mngon du 'gyur ro/ /tshad med drug dang sbyar na/ oṃ thugs rje chen po tshad med/ ma byams pa tshad med/ ṇi snying rje tshad med/ pad dga' ba tshad med/ me btang snyoms tshad med/ hūṃ chos nyid tshad med de de rnams ky-i sgo nas gzhan don byed pa yang ma ṇis 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /rigs drug gi sdug bsngal sbyong ba dang sbyar na/ oṃ gyis lha 'chi 'pho 'og tu lhung ba'i sdug bsngal sbyong*/ mas lha min 'thab rtsod kyi sdug bsngal sbyong*/ ṇis mi'i 'chi 'pho'i sdug bsngal sbyong*/ pad kyis byol song glen lkugs kyi sdug bsngal sbyong*/ mes yi dwags bkrais skom gy-i sdug bsngal sbyong*/ hūṃ gis dmyal ba'i tsha grang gi sdug bsngal kun sbyong bar byed pa yang yig drug bzlas pas 'grub po/ /rigs drug gi skye sgo gcod pa dang sbyar na/ oṃ gyis las nyon gyi dbang gis lhar skye ba'i skye sgo g.yang sa gcod/ mas lha min du skye ba'i g.yang sa gcod/ ṇis mir skye ba'i g.yang sa gcod/ pad kyis byol song du skye ba'i g.yang sa gcod/

mes yi dwags su skye ba'i g.yang sa gcod/ hūṃ gis dmyal bar skye ba'i g.yang sa gcod pa yang yig drug gis 'grub bo/ /rigs drug gi don byed pa dang sbyar na/ oṃ la sogs drug gis thub pa drug mtshon zhing*/ lha la sogs pa rigs drug gi don sna tshogs byed pa yang 'grub bo/ /sgrib pa drug sbyong ba dang sbyar na/ oṃ gyis lus kyi sgrib pa sbyong*/ mas ngag gi sgrib pa/ ṇis yid kyi sgrib pa/ pad kyis nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa/ mes bag chags kyi sgrib pa/ hūṃ gis shes bya'i sgrib pa sbyong ngo*/ /gsol 'debs dang sbyar na/ oṃ gyis sku/ mas gsung*/ ṇis thugs/ pad kyis yon tan/ mes 'phrin las/ hūṃ gis de lnga la gsol ba 'debs pa 'grub bo/ /byin rlabs 'byung ba dang sbyar na/ oṃ gyis lus la sku'i byin rlabs/ mas ngag la gsung gi byin rlabs/ ṇis yid la thugs kyi byin rlabs/ pad kyis yon tan gyi byin rlabs/ mes 'phrin las kyi byin rlabs/ hūṃ gis byin rlabs de thams cad 'byung ngo*/ /gzhan yang*/ yig drug gis nyan rang byang sems dge bsnyen bsnyen gnas sngags sdom rnams srung bar 'gyur zhes dang*/ yang sku gsung thugs gsum dang rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig dang dam tshig nyams chags rnams skong bar 'gyur zhes dang*/ yang*/ lha dbang sngags dbang chos dbang bum dbang gsang dbang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang drug gi sgo gsum la bskur nas smin par byed ces dang*/ yang*/ yig drug gis rim pa bzhin du sangs rgyas chos dge 'dun bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams la skyabs su 'gro zhing skyob par 'gyur zhes dang*/ yang*/ smon sems 'jug sems gnyis dang gnyis med dang chos nyid dang ye shes dang don dam byang chub kyi sems bskyed par 'gyur zhes dang*/ gzhan yang*/ chos nyid kyi don dang sbyar ba dang*/ gnad dang sbyar ba/ lta sgom dang sbyar ba/ yin lugs dang sbyar ba/ phyi'i 'byung ba dang sbyar ba/

nang gi 'byung ba dang sbyar ba/ gsang ba'i 'byung ba dang sbyar ba/ don chos nyid dang sbyar ba/ spros bral dang sbyar ba/ mtshon dpe dang sbyar ba/ srung ba dang sbyar ba/ nad 'don pa dang sbyar ba'i bar drug tshan sum cu rtsa drug bshad kyang rgyas par ma bkod do/ /yang 'di ltar bshad de/ khyab brdal chen po'i gnas mchog tu/ /drug pa thugs rje chen po yis/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūṃ brjod pas/ /rtag chad ma spangs gnas su dag /lha ltung ba'i sdug bsngal zhi bar byas/ /des na ngo mtshar che zhes bya/ /kun gyis ma ṇi padme sgrongs/ /ma ṇis sgrib pa sbyong ba ni/ /sum cu rtsa gsum lha yul na/ /lha bu dri ma med pa yis/ /mtshams med lnga yi las byas pas/ /rdo rje'i dmyal bar skye ba la/ /brgya byin lha yi thub pa yis/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūṃ brjod pas/ /rdo rje'i dmyal nas thon nas ni/ /rdo rje lta bu'i dgongs pa shar/ /des na sgrib pa sbyong zhes bya/ /kun gyis ma ṇi padme sgrongs/ /ri rab chen po'i khong seng na/ /lha min snang byed ces bya bas/ /srog gcod byas pa'i rnam smin gyis/ /tsha ba'i dmyal bar skyes pa la/ /bcom ldan thags bzang thub pa des/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūṃ brjod pas/ tsha ba'i dmyal pa'i gnas nas thar/ /dpa' bar 'gro ba'i rtogs pa shar/ /des na= kun gyis= ma ga ngha yi grong khyer du/ /stobs ldan bu ni ma skyes dgras/ /pha bsad pa yi rnam smin gyis/ /grang ba'i dmyal bar skyes pa la/ /bcom ldan shākya thub pa yis/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūṃ brjod pas/ /grang ba'i dmyal ba'i gnas nas thar/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i dgongs pa shar/ /des na= kun gyi= gang bzang bu ni lnga brtsegs kyis/ /sangs rgyas gser thub bstan pa la/ /dam pa'i chos la skur pa btab/ /de yi rnam smin dud 'gror skyes/ /sgrib sel shākya seṅge yis/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūṃ brjod pas/ glen lkugs byol song gnas nas thar/ /gsal la mi rtog dgongs pa shar/

des na= kun gyis= rgyal bu mdzes ldan bya ba yis/ /khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin la/ /ser sna 'jur gegs cher byas pas/ de yi rnam smin yi dwags skyes/ /'phags pa nam mkha' mdzod chen gyis/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūṃ brjod pas/ /yi dwags bkres skom gnas nas thar/ /longs spyod 'gags med dgongs pa shar/ /des na= kun gyis= gyad yul mi'u thung sor 'phreng gis/ /mi stong dang dgu brgya go dgu bsad/ /dmyal khams bco brgyad gnas su lhung*/ /thub pa'i dbang po stobs can gyis/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūṃ brjod pas/ /tsha grang sdug bsngal zhi bar gyur/ /seṅge'i stobs kyi dgongs pa shar/ /de ltar sgrib pa spyong zhes bya/ /kun gyis ma ṇi padme sgrongs/ /zhes sogs mang du 'byung yang ma bris so/ /spyir ma ṇi bgrang ba'i phan yon gong du brjaud pa ltar yin la/ khyad par du dam pa drug gis zin pa'i sgo nas ma ṇi brgya rtsa brgyad re bzlas na mdo sde 'gyur ro cog bklag pa dang phan yon mnyam par 'byung bar gsungs te/ dam pa drug ni/ ma ṇi sems can thams cad kyi don du dmigs nas 'don pa sbyin pa'i phar phyin/ de'i skabs su sgo gsum gyi nyes spyod spong ba tshul khṛms/ gzhan gyi gnod pa dang dka' spyad la bzod pa bzod pa/ brtson 'grus cher byas nas 'don pa brtson 'grus/ sems mi g.yeng bar 'don pa bsam gtan/ gang shar rang grol stong pa nyid du lta ba ni shes rab kyi phar phyin du bshad pa ltar ro/ /gzhan yang khyer so gsum yum dang ldan pa'i sgo nas ton na 'gyur dang phan yon lhag par che bar bshad de/ rang nyid spyan ras gzigs su bsgoms pa dang*/ gzhan gang zag tu snang ba thams cad kyang spyan ras gzigs su sgom pa snang ba sku'i khyer so/ sgra grags tshad thams cad yig drug gi sgrar mos pa grags stong gsung gi khyer so/ yul snang kun stong pa nyid kyi bdag nyid du lta ba dran rtogs thugs kyi khyer so ste khyer so gsum mo/

/ma ṇi sgra chung ngus ton kyang chog mod/ gzhan phan gyi bsam pas skad chen pos gsal bar ton na sgra de dud 'gro sogs gang gis thos pa de'i sgrib pa ci rigs sbyong nus pa sogs kyi phan yon yod par bshad de rgyas par ma bkod la/ shes par 'dod na za ma tog bkod pa'i mdo dang*/ ma ṇi bka' 'bum du blta bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang za ma tog bkod pa'i mdo las gang la me chu mtshon cha sogs kyi 'jigs pa brgyad byung ba'i tshe yig drug bzla zhing spyan ras gzigs kyi mtshan nas brjaud de phyag 'tshal ba dang gsol 'debs byas na 'jigs pa de dag las thar bar 'gyur la/ skyes bu gang zhig bu 'dod na snying nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi mtshan nas bos te bdag la bu pho stsol cig ces gsol ba drag tu btab na sngon las ma gtogs bu pho stsol bar 'gyur zhing*/ de bzhin du bu mo 'dod na'ang stsol bar bshad/ phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar 'dod na'ang de'i ched du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba btab na bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur zhes 'di'i gzhung du ma las bshad pa ltar yin te/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs ni sangs rgyas 'od dpag med dang ngo bo dbyer med dang sras kyi thu bo'ang yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gong du bshad pa rnams ni spyan ras gzigs kyi bsngags pa dang yig drug gi phan yon gtso bor brjod pa yin la/ da ni sbyin bdag gi che ba'i khyad par cung zad brjod par bya ste/ de yang spyir yig drug gi phan yon chos rgyal bsrong btsan sgam po rjes 'brang dang bcas pas rgyas par bshad pa'i rjes su 'brang nas skya ser kun dang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag dad ldan rnams kyis yig drug 'don pa dang*/ ma ṇi ril sgrub mdzad pa'i srol bzang po yul dbus gtsang nas bzung ste shar rgyal khams chen po'i bar dar zhing rgyas pa 'di bzhin yin la/ spyir ril sgrub ma byas kyang mi mang tshogs nas ma ṇi bzlas na'ang phan yon che mod/

ril sgrub mdzad pa'i dgos pa ni/ de ltar bsgrub pa'i ril bu de gang gis dad pas zos na rgyud la lha dang sngags kyi byin rlabs zhugs nas sdig sgrib byang nas mngon mtho khyad par can dang nges legs 'grub par 'gyur bas khyad che'o/ /ma ṇi ril sgrub mdzad pa na grangs dung 'phyur song na ni dgos pa'i don gyi gtso bo 'grub pa yin gyi/ de'i tshe ril bu 'bab srid kyang de 'bab dgos par gzhung dag las ma bshad pas/ 'bab pa tsam la dga' zhing ya mtshan du 'dzin pa ni byis pa'i bsam pa'o/ /mdo smad co ne'i phyogs 'dir ni sngon dad ldan du mas ma ṇi ril sgrub mdzad cing*/ co ne'i dpon yab sras rnams kyis kyang sngar rang gi pho brang du ril sgrub lan bdun mdzad par grags so/ /khyad par du da lta sa skyong chen po mi dbang 'jam dbyangs nor bu'i mdzad pa las brtsams te cung zad brjod na/ khong gis 'jig rten lugs kyi srid skyong spyi dang bye brag rang gi pho brang chen po dang gnas 'di gnyis ka'ang gzhi nas gsar bcos kyis bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa ji ltar mdzad pa dang*/ chos phyogs nas gser yum gyis gtsos pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten du ma pho brang chen mo dang 'di nyid du'ang bzhengs pa'i dkar chags ni logs su gsal ba ltar yin la/ 'dir rang gi bzhugs gnas zur bar sa phag gi lor ma ṇi ril sgrub ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul mdor bsdus tshigs bcad du sbyar te brjod par bya'o/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos blo bzang rgyal bstan 'dir/ /mtho rigs khang bzang rtse nas mngon 'phags shing*/ /lugs zung 'dod rgu'i 'byung gnas nor bu zhig /thub bstan rgyal mtshan mdzes pa'i dpal du shar/ /dad stobs rnam dpyod ldan pa'i sa skyong des/ /bstan dang 'gro la phan pa'i ched dgongs te/ /nyer mkho'i yo byad dgos cha mang sbyar nas/ /phag lo'i lnga pa snron gyi zla ba la/ /'phel gdung gser dngul mu tig byi ru sogs/

/rin chen rigs dang byin rten rnam mang dang*/ dam rdzas ril bu dri sman sna tshogs pa/ /bsres pa'i rgyu las ril bu mang bsgril te/ /dge 'dun sum brgya skye bo'i 'du tshogs bcas/ /bsnyen bkur zhag bcu'i bar la nyin mtshan du/ /ma ṇi grangs tshad dung 'phyur gnyis tsam zhig /'gro bar byas nas legs par bsgrubs par mdzad/ /de tshe mi dbang 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis/ /brgya mchod lan mang mdzad pas char dus 'babs/ /mi rnams chos dang zang zing dga' ston la/ /rtse dgas rol ba'i skal ba ldan par gyur/ /de ltar bum sgrub mdzad pa'i gnas skabs su/ /ril bu lhar bskyed rgyal ba sras bcas kyi/ /byin rlabs nus mthu bkug nas bstim pa la/ /ma ṇi dung 'phyur bzlas sgrub byin gyis brlabs/ /bzang bzang dam rdzas byin rten kun tshogs shing*/ /mang mang dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde rnams kyis/ /yang yang sgom bzlas mdzad nas bsgrubs 'di rnams/ /gang gang spyad na mngon mtho nges legs 'grub/ /de ltar sgrub phyir sgo gsum rab 'bad rab mang rgyu tshogs btang ba las/ /las dkar ji snyed thob des gnas 'dir gnas skabs mi 'dod nyer 'tshe kun/ /kun nas zhi zhing phyi mar skye dang skye bar dal rten rim brgyud de/ /de nyid gzigs pa'i go 'phang myur bar myur du nges par thob gyur cig /khyad par sa skyong mi dbang 'khor bcas kyi/ /mi mthun phyogs zhi mthun rkyen thams cad dang*/ /lugs gnyis mnga' thang dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel zhing*/ /bde skyid dga' ston dpal la spyod gyur cig /ces ma ṇi'i phan yon gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me zhes bya ba 'di ni/ thub bstan spyi dang 'jam dpal snying po'i bstan pa la phan 'dod kyi lhag bsam can dad dang rnam dpyod ldan pa'i co ne'i sa skyong chen po mi dbang 'jam dbyangs nor bus bstan 'gro'i don la dmigs nas bzhugs gnas zur ba gsar bskrun mar ris bkra shis khang gsar bsam 'grub pho brang ces bya bar/

ma ṇi'i bum sgrub mdzad pa'i tshe 'di lta bu zhig gyis dang*/ gzhan la'ang phan ched kho bos bar du bsgrub par bya'o zhes gsung gis bskul ba la brten nas/ g.yo sa'i khri zur du 'bod pa bshad sgrub ming can gyis gnas de nyid du mgyogs par sbyar ba ste/ dad dang rnam dpyod zung du 'brel ba g.yo sa'i dge slong sangs rgyas rgya mtshos sngar dpon gyis brkos pa de par thung chung stobs kyis gsung 'bum du 'jug mi bde bas 'di slar kho bos par du bsgrubs nas nyid kyi gsung 'bum gral du 'jug par bya'o zhes khas blangs pa'i tshe par gyi yi ge ba ni tā yi la lung blo bzang don grub bo/ /maṅgalaṃ// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/ ma ṇi'i phan yon gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me bzhugs/ - PAGE 316-- PAGE 317-- PAGE 303-
